units.source_text: 源氏公子正欲命驾启程之际，左大臣家众人簇拥着诸公子前来迎接了。

en.t: Just as Prince Genji was about to order his carriage and set out, people from the Minister of the Left's household came to meet him, escorting the young nobles.

units.source_text: 众人说：“公子没有说明到什么地方去，原来在此！”

en.t: They said, "You did not tell us where you were going, my lord, and here you are!"

units.source_text: 公子所特别亲近的头中将及其弟左中弁，以及其他诸公子，先后来到。

en.t: The Captain, with whom the prince was especially close, his younger brother the Lesser Controller of the Left, and the other young nobles arrived one after another.

units.source_text: 他们恨恨地对源氏公子说道：“这等好去处，你没有约我们同来取乐，太无情了！”

en.t: They complained resentfully to Prince Genji, "It was heartless of you not to invite us along to enjoy such a wonderful place!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子道：“此间花荫景色甚美，若不稍稍休憩而匆匆归去，未免遗憾。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "The view here beneath the blossoms is very beautiful. It would be a pity to hurry home without resting a little."

units.source_text: 便相将在岩石荫下青苔地上环坐，举杯共饮。

en.t: So they led one another to the mossy ground in the shade of the rocks, sat in a circle, raised their cups, and drank together.

units.source_text: 一旁山泉轻泻，形成瀑布，饶有佳趣。

en.t: Beside them, a mountain spring flowed gently down into a waterfall, creating a scene of great charm.

units.source_text: 头中将探怀取出笛来，吹出一支清澄的曲调。

en.t: The Captain reached into his robe, took out a flute, and played a clear, pure melody.

units.source_text: 左中弁用扇子按拍，唱出催马乐“闻道葛城寺，位在丰浦境……”之歌[\[19\]](#part1334.html#m19)。

en.t: The Lesser Controller of the Left beat time with his fan and sang the saibara song, "I hear that Katsuragi Temple lies within the borders of Toyoura..."[\[19\]](#part1334.html#m19).

units.source_text: 这两人都是矫矫不群的贵公子。

en.t: Both of these men were noble young gentlemen who stood out from the rest.

units.source_text: 而源氏公子病后清减，倦倚岩旁，其丰姿之秀美，盖世无双，使得众人注视，目不转睛。

en.t: Prince Genji, however, had grown slender after his illness and leaned wearily beside a rock; the beauty of his graceful figure was unmatched in the world, and everyone gazed at him without taking their eyes away.

units.source_text: 有一个随从吹奏筚篥，又有吹笙的风流少年。

en.t: One attendant played the hichiriki, and there was also an elegant youth playing the sho.

units.source_text: 僧都亲自抱了一张七弦琴来，对公子说：“务请妙手操演一曲，如蒙俯允，山鸟定当惊飞。”

en.t: The bishop himself brought a seven-stringed zither in his arms and said to the prince, "Please favor us with one piece from your masterful hands. If you grant us this, even the mountain birds will surely startle and fly up."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“心绪紊乱，深恐不能成声。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "My heart is unsettled, and I fear deeply that I may not be able to produce a proper sound."

units.source_text: 但也适当地弹了一曲，然后偕众人一同上道。

en.t: Even so, he played a suitable piece, and then set out on the road together with everyone.
